items.summaryText: Q1: What is an inclusive playground?
items.pText: An inclusive playground is a play space where children of all abilities, including those with disabilities, can play together safely and comfortably.

items.summaryText: Q2: Why are inclusive playgrounds important?
items.pText: They ensure every child has the right to play, learn, and make friends, regardless of their abilities, and help build empathy and a sense of belonging.

items.summaryText: Q3: What features make a playground inclusive?
items.pText: Features like ramps, wide pathways, sensory play panels, accessible swings, and soft flooring make playgrounds usable for children with different needs.

items.summaryText: Q4: Are inclusive playgrounds expensive to build?
items.pText: Not necessarily. Many inclusive features can be added using smart design and local materials, making them affordable for most communities.

items.summaryText: Q5: How can I help bring an inclusive playground to my area?
items.pText: You can raise awareness, talk to local authorities, join community groups, and share the needs of children in your area to encourage the creation of inclusive play spaces.
